features: Ergonomic Vertical Curve Design for Natural Comfort : The sculpted vertical curve promotes a natural hand grip that significantly reduces wrist strain making this wireless mouse ideal for long hours of work, study, or creative tasks on your laptop or desktop.

Triple-Device Wireless Connectivity : Connect and switch between 2 Bluetooth devices and 1 USB 2.4GHz receiver with a dedicated switch button making this bluetooth mouse a versatile wireless mouse for laptop and multi-device users who need seamless transitions.

Horizontal Scroll Wheel for Enhanced Productivity : The built-in side scroll wheel lets you navigate effortlessly through wide spreadsheets, design timelines, and broad documents saving time and reducing reliance on keyboard shortcuts during intensive work sessions.

Silent Kailh Switches Across All 7 Buttons : Seven whisper-quiet Kailh buttons ensure a distraction-free experience in any environment whether you're in a shared office, library, or home workspace for focused, interruption-free productivity.

Adjustable DPI up to 3200 with 5 Precision Levels : Fine-tune cursor sensitivity with 5 DPI levels for precise control across a range of tasks from detailed editing work to fast-paced browsing giving you adaptable performance as a wireless mouse for laptop use.

800mAh Rechargeable Battery via Type-C : The built-in wireless mouse rechargeable 800mAh battery delivers extended usage on a single charge, with modern USB-C fast charging keeping downtime to a minimum and you focused on your work.

Smart Battery Indicator for Uninterrupted Use : Battery level is displayed directly on your connected device, so you're always aware of remaining charge and can plan ahead ensuring your wireless mouse never dies at a critical moment.
